I will do mostly what worked for me last season, but I will keep the cash side tight because this plot is small and I cannot risk spending too much. If I get fertilizer in time, I will put some on this maize and use hybrid seed, because I have seen neighbors here in Dowa get a better stand and better cobs that way. I will also add compost from home, I will not irrigate, and I will weed by hand instead of buying chemicals.
